$comment: The one list of repositories that make up the AI Video Production ecosystem. install.sh / scripts/bootstrap.sh install exactly what is listed here, and docs/ecosystem/registry.json must name the same repositories (checked by scripts/tests/test_ecosystem_manifest.py). To add a Skill to the ecosystem, add it here.

components.role: Orchestrator: plans a production and calls the Skills below
Execution engine: typed FFmpeg/ffprobe tools every delegating Skill runs on
Colour correction, LUT, HDR to SDR
TTS, voice replacement, fitting translated lines to source timing, audio description
Upload and metadata for delivery platforms, platform delivery specs
Observation only: measures facts about a media file
Slide import, slide-change detection, slide text
